purpose: Display math with \int and \sum limits, \frac, \sqrt, superscripts and a \left( ... \right) pair.
notes: Display box region metrics use this fixture; \left( \right) delimiters may be unsupported by the current compiler.
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
